name: CQUniCares Student Success Scholarship
summary: Donor-funded scholarship for CQUniversity students whose financial circumstances are affecting their study.
key: Up to $5,000, paid per term by study load.
who: Enrolled in a CQUniversity higher education diploma, undergraduate or postgraduate course
Studying at least 12 credit points at census
Experiencing financial circumstances affecting participation and success
Australian or New Zealand citizen, permanent resident or humanitarian visa holder
how: Eligible students are emailed instructions on how to apply
catches: Offered by targeted email invitation; the Term 2, 2026 round has closed

evidence.quote: Be experiencing financial circumstances affecting participation and success
Eligible enrolled students will receive a direct email to their student account with instructions on how to apply.
